title: King Suite • Private Bath & Entry • Near Nissan
description:
Comfortable private primary suite with private full bath in a quiet Smyrna home just 25 minutes from downtown Nashville and 10 minutes to Murfreesboro. Ideal for travel nurses, professionals, or couples visiting Music City.

King sized Tempur Pedic Mattress, 65” Smart TV, mini fridge, microwave, dedicated workspace. Enjoy shared access to fully stocked kitchen, washer/dryer, workout equipment, fenced backyard, and plenty of FREE parking. Great home base for Music City fun!

The space
Enjoy a private, fully furnished suite in a spacious Smyrna home just outside Nashville. The suite features a king bed, private full bath, dedicated workspace, and 60” Smart TV, mini-fridge and microwave making it perfect for short visits or longer stays.

Guest access
Shared space includes fully equipped kitchen, living room, dining room and backyard. There is also gym available for guests in the garage.

Smart locks on all exterior and bedroom doors for your privacy and convenience.  This space also features a private entrance.

During your stay
Other guests may occupy other bedrooms. Why guests love staying here

✔ Quiet residential neighborhood
✔ Easy access to Nashville (25 minutes)
✔ Dedicated workspace for remote work
✔ Plenty of free parking
✔ Comfortable space for longer stays

Other things to note
Located in Smyrna, TN, about 25 minutes from downtown Nashville, 15 minutes to Murfreesboro and close to restaurants, shopping, and major highways.

Great for:
• Travel nurses
• Business travelers
• Visitors exploring Nashville
